title: UMI VLM Task and Trajectory Repetition Output
description: Strict output contract for task description and object-level robot-learnable manipulation trajectory cycles.

task_text.description: Exactly one sentence describing the goal of one complete object-manipulation trajectory.

task_family.description: Exactly one category from vocabulary.task_families. Replace or constrain this enum to the exact vocabulary supplied with the episode.

action.description: A 3 to 7 word imperative phrase describing the primary manipulation action.

n_repetitions.description: Number of distinct, complete, independently executed object-manipulation trajectories. Identical objects and repeated executions on the same object count separately when each is a distinct completed execution.

counting_reasoning.description: 2 to 5 sentences explaining trajectory starts and completions, how distinct executions were separated, excluded activities and their rationale, and how the three camera views were used.

repetitions.description: Chronologically ordered complete object-level manipulation trajectories. Each element is one robot-learnable execution, not one unique object or one unique task category.

start_step.description: First meaningful action step initiating this specific object-manipulation trajectory.

end_step.description: Last meaningful action step completing this specific object-manipulation trajectory. Must be greater than or equal to start_step.
